Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
My Korah has a Blessing of Chaos on her. Didi Meyers (one of my pred. vamp)
announces a bleed action: my question is: can I declare an attempt to block
before Didi plays any action modifiers? The correct timing is:
declare action
attempt to block
action mod of the acting minion
reactions of the blocking one
or
declare action and play action mod
attempt to block
